name: ts-agent-skill
description: Native Pi package for evidence-driven transition-state research with isolated operators.

scripts.install-env: python3 scripts/install_env.py --package-root . --workspace-root "${TS_WORKSPACE_ROOT:?set TS_WORKSPACE_ROOT to the TS workspace root}" --with-render --json
scripts.install-env:core: python3 scripts/install_env.py --package-root . --workspace-root "${TS_WORKSPACE_ROOT:?set TS_WORKSPACE_ROOT to the TS workspace root}" --json
scripts.test:pi-adapter: python3 scripts/ts_runtime.py run -m pytest -q tests/test_pi_agent_adapter.py tests/test_pi_subagent_contract.py tests/test_pi_compute_tools.py tests/test_pi_artifact_tools.py tests/test_pi_runtime_integration.py tests/test_agent_protocol.py
